changelog:
Freedom-to-Operate (FTO) search and analysis skill initial release:

- Enables comprehensive FTO patent search and infringement risk analysis using text or image input.
- Supports searches via Google Patents (free) and Patsnap (account required), across multiple jurisdictions.
- Outputs a complete FTO analysis report, including technical feature comparison table, search queries, relevant patent list, and risk assessment.
- Guides user through a step-by-step patent search workflow—from input collection, image analysis, technical decomposition, to risk reporting.
- Default settings focus only on granted and pending invention/utility patents; design and expired patents are excluded unless configured otherwise.
- Includes clear disclaimers and recommendations to consult a professional before acting on report findings.
summary: Conduct FTO patent searches and infringement risk analyses by querying granted and pending patents based on technical descriptions and images.
